input.prompt: Redesign this exact weapon into an unmistakable elegant two-handed industrial GREAT SWORD while preserving its waste-heat identity. Full weapon centered and completely visible in a straight front orthographic product view, vertical blade-up. Make a long tapered steel cutting blade with a sharp continuous silver edge and clear pointed tip; blade length dominates the silhouette. Reduce bulky pipe mass and make the two-hand grip as thin and refined as physically believable, wrapped dark leather, with a compact pommel. Keep machinery only around a compact guard/engine housing. Integrate one continuous orange-white hot thermal core INSIDE a deep recessed channel in the blade, framed by slim protective steel rails; the core is a coherent inset component with a clean isolated material surface, not a floating tube, not an overlay, not intersecting geometry. Brighter high-contrast PBR materials: readable silver gunmetal blade, dark forged frame, small brass mechanisms, vivid orange waste-heat core. Sleek lethal greatsword proportions, not a club, not a mace, not a blunt slab, not overly thick, no giant handle, no character, no hands, no stand, no floor, no text, transparent or plain black background, no cropping.
